title: The Quiet Aftermath
author: Ansel Ashgrove
blurb: Mara Zhou, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
